description: Replace mod-based sharding with a consistent-hash ring (virtual nodes) so removing one node only remaps that node's own keys
prompts: HashRing.kt's getNode picks a node with `Math.floorMod(key.hashCode(), nodes.size)` - removing or adding any node reshuffles almost every key. Implement a real consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes: the constructor takes (nodes: List<String>, replicas: Int) and places `replicas` virtual points per physical node around a ring, hashed via java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5") over "$node:$i" for each virtual point - not key.hashCode(), it's a weaker distribution. getNode(key: String): String hashes the key onto the ring and returns the node owning the next virtual point clockwise (wrapping around). addNode(node: String) and removeNode(node: String) update the ring in place.
name: add_kotlin_consistent_hash_ring
